page_content: The main iron swing in the children's park near the main chowk is rusted and the chain has snapped; it could seriously injure a child.
A heavy branch of an old tree in the park behind the civil hospital is half-broken and hanging right over the kids' slide area.
The fountain pool near the entrance has become a deep pit of stagnant green water with no fencing; a toddler could easily fall in.
Live electrical wires are sparking inside the open junction box of the park's decorative fountain; the ground is wet and dangerous.
A large cobra was spotted in the overgrown bushes near the children's sandpit; parents are in a state of panic.
The central gazebo structure in the community park is tilting and the pillars have developed deep cracks; it looks like it will collapse.
Broken glass bottles and sharp rusted metal scraps are scattered all over the jogging track near the metro pillar.
The manhole cover inside the park's walking path is missing, and the pit is full of fast-moving sewage water after the rain.
The main gate of the park is hanging by a single rusted hinge and could fall on someone at any moment.
Bees from a massive hive on the park's main archway have started attacking visitors; three people were stung this morning.
The multi-play station for toddlers has a cracked plastic slide with razor-sharp edges that has already caused a deep cut.
A pack of aggressive stray dogs has taken over the park's yoga pavilion and is chasing away senior citizens.
Raw sewage is leaking from a nearby pipe and flooding the entire kids' play area; the health risk is immediate.
The structural railing of the ornamental bridge over the park pond has broken off, leaving a dangerous gap over the deep water.
Someone has dumped a barrel of used engine oil near the park's flower beds; the fumes are making visitors nauseous.
The light pole in the center of the park is vibrating and sparking every time the wind blows; it is extremely unsafe.
A massive sinkhole has appeared in the lawn area near the library; it is hidden by long grass and very dangerous.
The roof of the park's security cabin has collapsed during the storm and the rubble is blocking the only emergency exit.
Vandals have set fire to the dry leaves and garbage pile inside the park; the flames are reaching the low-hanging tree branches.
The park's boundary wall near the nallah has collapsed, allowing antisocial elements to enter the area at any hour.
Foundations of the park's climbing wall are shifting, and the whole structure is swaying when kids use it.
A high-tension wire from the street has snapped and fallen onto the park's iron fencing; the entire perimeter is electrified.
Toxic chemical waste is being dumped by a nearby factory into the park's storm drain; the plants are dying instantly.
The concrete base of the gym equipment has cracked and the heavy iron bars are about to fall over.
A toddler nearly drowned in the uncovered septic tank of the public toilet inside the park today.
The park's overhead water tank is vibrating violently and leaking; we fear the structural support will fail soon.
Groups are using the park to store illegal gas cylinders behind the maintenance shed; this is a huge explosion risk.
A huge portion of the walking track has been washed away by a burst pipe, leaving a 4-foot deep trench.
The iron gate at the back entrance is rusted and sharp; a child got their hand stuck and badly injured.
Dead birds are found every morning near the park's fountain; we suspect the water has been poisoned or is toxic.
The walking track is completely broken with tiles jutting out near the market entrance, causing several senior citizens to trip.
Most of the benches in the park are broken or have nails sticking out, making them completely unusable.
The park lights have not been working for a week, and the whole area becomes a haven for antisocial elements after 6 PM.
The garbage bins in the park are overflowing and haven't been cleared for ten days; the stench is unbearable.
Stray cattle are frequently entering the park through the broken gate and destroying all the newly planted saplings.
The open gym equipment is rusted and jammed; the 'air walker' and 'chest press' don't move at all.
The public toilets inside the park are extremely filthy, the taps are stolen, and there is no water supply.
The children's sandpit is full of cat litter and plastic waste because it's never cleaned or covered.
Waterlogging on the central lawn has turned the park into a muddy mess where mosquitoes are breeding in thousands.
Unauthorized food stalls have set up inside the park entrance, dumping their leftover oil directly onto the grass.
The park's sprinkler system has a major leak, wasting thousands of liters of water every morning while the grass remains dry.
Loud music from the aerobics class in the park is disturbing the residents of the nearby apartment complex.
The information board showing the park's timings is completely defaced and unreadable.
The park's jogging track is being used by bikers to take shortcuts, making it unsafe for walkers.
There are no security guards present at the park during the late evening hours when most women come for a walk.
The drinking water cooler in the park hasn't worked since last summer; people have to bring their own bottles or go thirsty.
The lawn area is covered in dry weeds and thorns, making it impossible for children to play barefoot.
Unauthorized parking of rickshaws inside the park's main gate is blocking the pedestrian path.
The park's boundary fence is covered in illegal commercial posters and banners.
Stagnant water in the abandoned fish pond is smelling like rotten eggs and attracting swarms of flies.
The park's internal drainage system is choked with plastic, causing every rain to flood the walking tracks.
The shade structures over the benches are all torn and provide no protection from the sun or rain.
The park's nursery section is neglected; all the plants have dried up due to lack of watering.
People are washing their clothes and bathing at the public tap inside the park every morning.
The decorative statues in the park have been vandalized and parts of them are missing.
The park's clock tower hasn't worked for years and the glass faces are all broken.
Huge piles of pruned tree branches have been left in the middle of the lawn for over a month.
The park's pathways are pitch dark because the wiring for the bollard lights was stolen.
The entrance gate for the disabled is locked and the key is never with the guard.
The park's main lawn is being used by locals to dry their laundry and spices.
The bushes at the park entrance are overgrown and blocking the information signage.
The grass in the central lawn area needs a trim as it has grown too long for people to sit comfortably.
The paint on the park's main gate is peeling off and looks very neglected; needs a fresh coat.
A few of the decorative flower pots near the fountain are chipped and need replacement.
The 'Keep the Park Clean' sign near the primary school is faded and hard to read.
Dry leaves have accumulated in large quantities near the park's walking track corner.
The handles of the public benches are a bit dusty and need regular wiping.
Requesting more seasonal flowers to be planted in the beds near the colony gate entrance.
The numbering on the yoga pavilion steps has faded and needs a touch-up.
The grass at the edges of the jogging track is creeping onto the tiles.
A few old posters are still stuck to the base of the park's streetlight poles.
The park's information leaflet box is empty; please restock it for new visitors.
The gravel on the meditation path is uneven and needs to be leveled for a better experience.
Requesting a few more bird-feeders to be hung from the trees in the quiet zone.
The blue paint indicating the 'Senior Citizen Corner' is starting to look dull.
Some of the bricks around the tree basins are loose and need a bit of cement.
Requesting the removal of cobwebs from the top of the park's archway entrance.
The white wash on the park's boundary pillars is getting stained by the rain.
The 'Use Dustbin' stickers on the park's trash cans are peeling off at the corners.
A small amount of silt has gathered at the entrance of the park's parking lot.
Requesting a fresh coat of anti-rust paint for the park's small pedestrian bridge.
The plastic chain across the 'Staff Only' area is broken and needs replacement.
One of the direction signs inside the park is slightly tilted.
Requesting a small display board showing the names of the different tree species in the park.
The 'No Littering' board near the library is partially covered by a tree branch.
The door to the park's tool shed needs some oiling as it squeaks loudly.
A bit of moss has grown on the shaded side of the park's concrete seating area.
The height-marker for the park's car parking entrance is slightly faded.
Requesting a few more 'Do Not Pluck Flowers' signs near the rose garden.
The color-coding on the park's waste bins needs to be more clearly defined.
